fields.label: Payer
fields.description: Who actually funded this subscription — the sponsoring partner, or the student themselves when self-paying (#33 provenance).

fields.label: Amount
fields.description: What was charged for this student's period — the PAYER's rate (#23/#30: the partner discount belongs to whoever pays).

fields.label: Rate Kind
fields.description: Which rate the amount reflects, recorded so a later audit can tell charges apart without recomputing history: Base/Partner = the LMS Settings monthly rates (#23/#30), Plan = an LMS Plan record's own price (one-off programmes, yearly plans), Lesson = a per-lesson once-off.

fields.label: Months
fields.description: Months of coverage bought. 0 for one-off charges (programme window purchases, per-lesson) — the period fields say what the charge actually covered.

fields.label: Plan
fields.description: The LMS Plan record this charge priced from, when checkout was plan-aware. Empty for legacy months-only checkouts.

fields.label: Lesson
fields.description: Per-lesson purchases only: the ONE lesson this once-off charge paid for ("you attend a lesson you are required to pay"). This row IS the lesson's access grant — course.get_lesson_session honours it.

fields.label: Period End
fields.description: The LMS Subscription Period this payment bought (#27/#30 entitlement resolution reads the period rows themselves; this is the payment-side mirror).
